purpose: Deterministic non-overlapping ownership for 10-thread absorption canonical workers.

stableRecordKey.normalization: No case folding, trimming, Unicode rewriting, or field reordering after the stable key components have been canonically selected.

hash.projection: first 8 digest bytes interpreted as unsigned big-endian 64-bit integer

rules: Workers MUST NOT process a record whose bucket is outside their ownership set.
A record is canonical only after its durable canonical ledger write exists.
Source provenance is immutable and remains independently preserved.
Changing this contract requires a new version; V1 records are never silently re-sharded.
